descricao_meta: Kite lessons, gear rental, airport transfer and downwinders in Cumbuco, Ceará, with certified schools. Request online and confirm on WhatsApp.
hero_titulo: Kitesurfing in Cumbuco, from first lesson to downwinder
hero_texto: Lessons, rental, transfers and downwinders with certified schools, 30 km from Fortaleza. Pick a package and we confirm everything on WhatsApp.
vento_texto: The season runs from July to January and peaks from August to October. Steady southeast wind, cross-shore.
pacotes_texto: Reference prices in Brazilian reais. The final price, with dates and school, is confirmed on WhatsApp before you pay anything.

faq.pergunta: When is the best time to go?
faq.resposta: July to January. August to October has the strongest wind and the most demand, so book early.
